meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析RNA-seq数据并寻找转录因子与靶基因的调控关系。
copy.tagline_en: Infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing RNA-seq data to find transcription factor-target gene relationships.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 能运行 Python 代码，从基因表达数据（如 RNA-seq）推断基因调控网络，找出哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因，并给出调控重要性评分。
howto.when: 当用户提供基因表达数据文件（如 TSV），并要求分析转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 arboreto 从这份 RNA-seq 数据推断基因调控网络。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据并运行 GRNBoost2 算法。

say.text: 用 GENIE3 算法分析单细胞表达数据，输出所有调控关系。
say.note: Claude 会切换为随机森林方法。

say.text: 比较对照和处理组的调控网络，分别推断。
say.note: Claude 会遍历多个条件运行 GRNBoost2。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can run Python code to infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data (e.g., RNA-seq), identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes with importance scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a gene expression data file (e.g., TSV) and asks to analyze transcription factor-target gene regulatory relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this RNA-seq data using arboreto.
say_en.note: Claude will load the data and run GRNBoost2.

say_en.text: Analyze single-cell expression with GENIE3 and output all links.
say_en.note: Claude switches to random forest method.

say_en.text: Compare networks for control and treatment groups, inferring each separately.
say_en.note: Claude iterates over conditions with GRNBoost2.
